name: Exploding Statue
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
description: A hollow statue filled with explosives is connected to a trip wire running along the adjacent door.
disable: DC 21 Thievery (trained) to safely cut the wire

generalAbilities.name: Explosion
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the northern door without first disabling the trip wire

Effect The statue explodes, spraying shrapnel to the west in a 5ft Cone and dealing (1d10+7) Piercing Damage]{1d10+7 piercing and 1d10 fire} damage to all creatures in the affected area (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save).
